title_or_table: New Residential Construction, New Privately-Owned Housing Units Completed, annual data, by units in structure (comps_cust.xlsx, sheet Annual)
universe_or_base: New privately owned housing units completed, by the number of units in the building
qualification: Survey-based estimates of completions; detail may not add to total because of rounding, and the latest year is revised with later releases. The stacked parts are buildings of one unit, two to four units, and five or more units

two_to_four_units_thousands.description: units in buildings of 2 to 4 units

five_or_more_units_thousands.description: units in buildings of 5 or more units
